action.objective: Verify d2d3 at full depth as the reserved development move, checking for tactical refutations and comparing to alternatives.
action.rationale: Broad search at depth 3 suggested d2d3 (score 92, exact) as the top candidate, with d2d4 also scoring 92 but bound=upper. d2d3 develops the center, opens the c1 bishop, and supports e4 expansion while keeping king safety. Verification at depth 4 with the reserved 2000 nodes will confirm safety and produce commit-ready evidence.
